items.title: George Guesnon Interview
items.q: There was a band that was Kid Clayton on trumpet, George Williams on drum, Tink Batiste on piano, Pete Beatty playing saxophone, and Earl Stockmeyer playing banjo.

ctx.x: What kind of a band was that?

Well, there was a five-piece band. There was a band that was Kid Clayton on trumpet, George Williams on drum, Tink Batiste on piano, Pete Beatty playing saxophone, and Earl Stockmeyer playing banjo. So after I went there that first night and I saw that, to me, that was a new world. I felt like somebody who got rejuvenated all over again. I knew that was the life for me, that and no other life. So I began to hang in the place every night. I practically lived in it. So I got to become friends with the band. I'd…

But Lawrence isn't here to talk about him anymore. And you're one of the few people that really could describe. Did he play mostly the chord style? Just say four beats to a major. Did he put in extra beats?
